code_readback.clip_source_field_not_applicable: data.source refers to an earlier clip, not a still alias; no video schema field or keyframes manifest was invented.
code_readback.native_supported_route: Official keyframes --shot and the ordinary exact-request cache, with an explicit live-cache byte/SHA check before the teaser invocation.
code_readback.cache_identity: Stage.imageKey includes provider/model/composed prompt/negative/reference SHA/seed/dimensions and image-selection version. Camera and cast enter the composed prompt. Scene IDs/output target do not enter the key.
code_readback.cache_miss_is_not_safe_for_reuse: Stage.generate can submit a new provider job on a cache miss. Therefore equal planned keys alone are insufficient; a missing, changed or mismatched live cache entry/file stops the pair before the teaser CLI command.
code_readback.judge_scope: Each narration scene still needs its own official judge result; request equality does not share or replace either acceptance.

preconditions: New exact source/visual and fresh narrative reviews, owner outline/script approval, true production admission and whole-film quote are still required. Nothing here starts paid work.

Read actual model/provider/version, size, look, prompt budget, cast/style-reference SHA, correction list and seed from the admitted execution context. Recompute both live Stage.imageKey values using those actual identical inputs; the example tuple above is not backend readback.
Keep the pair in one unchanged project/workdir and serialize its operations. Do not run another writer, retake, cache cleaner or competing generation between preflight and reuse.

first.purpose: Only after normal admission: generate payoff once, then independently judge that scene.
first.require: That exact first take must pass and remain selected. Record the real cache key, source file path, bytes/SHA, job and ledger receipt; no retake/correction or second seed.

before_second_command_required.live_cache_read: Immediately before invoking the teaser, read readCache(projectWorkdir).entries[recomputedLiveKey] and the real entry.file under that workdir.
require_all: Both recomputed live keys are equal and match the accepted payoff first-take key.
The cache entry exists and its file still exists. Read and SHA256 the actual file bytes; require equality with cache entry.sha256 and the recorded accepted payoff source-file SHA.
Resolve the actual source file path and require it is the very file registered for that accepted payoff request; no substitute, expired entry, unsupported alias or unresolved path.
The source scene still selects that accepted first take; model/version/references/size/seed/correction and cache state have not changed.
before_second_command_required.on_any_failure: STOP BEFORE THE TEASER COMMAND. A cache miss is not permission to generate; restore/reconcile the legitimately accepted shared asset through the normal owner-approved route, never buy a similar second image.

second.purpose: Invoke only after the live-cache byte/SHA preflight passes; this must reuse the existing source file.
second.require: Preserve actual reused=true cache/job receipts and apply the teaser scene official judge. If reuse is absent or either scene needs a retake, stop the pair.

production_handoff.on_any_failure_or_changed_request: Stop the pair. Do not change only one endpoint, reroll a seed, buy an independently corrected look-alike, use --force/--accept-best, or hand-edit a manifest. If a factual/style correction is necessary, update both ends and repeat the normal exact-bound source/visual and admitted production process within existing account/take caps.
actual_verification_required: Read the real official keyframes manifest only after both scene judges. Require both final selected references to resolve to the identical file, then SHA256 its actual bytes; preserve each actual assignment and verdict.
If either source is trimmed, verify both final selections and assembly inputs use the same derived file and actual SHA. Equality of pre-trim source hashes is insufficient.
Preserve real generation, cache-hit, judge, trim, selected-manifest, assembly and ledger receipts and confirm no duplicate teaser image purchase.
Until those actual checks pass, every file/SHA and actual_same_asset_verified stays null/false. Matching prompt/key or a written plan is not generated-image acceptance or media QA.
